text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a mile-long race and, appropriate for
its G1
status, demands total
concentration from start to
finish. With
tension at an all-time high, Sweep
Tosho
clings to her hopes of victory...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! Did you see that final stretch?! She just refused to back down!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I don't know how she pulled that off, but that performance had me pinching myself something fierce! Sweep Tosho, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Sweeeeep! Do your best in the
Takarazuka Kinen!
No, wait... Go out and
win that thing! We'll be
cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: People on Their Phones
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! That Yasuda Kinen was absolutely incrrrredible!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, right... It should be over by now...

text_block_list.name: People on Their Phones
text_block_list.text: OMG, that was so lit! And did you see what Sweep Tosho did at the end?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I don't even need to hear the details to
know
what happened. I'm sure that you
ran a great race
and captured everyone's
hearts, Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And next, you're going to head to the
Takarazuka
Kinen, ready to cast your
magic and realize that
dream of yours to
change the world.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Because that's who you are.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You always manage to be the coolest.
That's
probably why...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I've always dreamed of being your rival.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh! ...Hello?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Yes, that's fine. I'll be back in time!
Yes...
Yes. I'm sorry for worrying you.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Okay, then. I'm looking forward to
running with
you, Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who will be the protagonist of this
story? The
witch who has finally
completed her incantation...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Or the newly awoken hero? We'll find
out at the
Takarazuka Kinen.
